dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...I've been accepted into the Akademiya! Haha, congratulations to me! I don't want to be some warrior's wife! I'm going to be Siman, the Great Sage!"

dialogues.speaker: Battered Notebook
dialogues.text: "Hehe... Irfan the 'Great Musician' and Khayyam 'the Wise,' eh? Don't forget me! Especially you, Khayyam! Don't you forget me!"

dialogues.speaker: Battered Notebook
dialogues.text: "...Farewell, notebook! Farewell, Irfan and Siman, my best friends! I hope that the forest never forgets our story, and I hope we remember each other..."

dialogues.speaker: Battered Notebook
dialogues.text: (...The rest is messy and filled with the children's happy and sorrowful memories...)

dialogues.speaker: Battered Notebook
dialogues.text: "...Aranakin disappeared. I have no idea when, but he's really gone. It's time for me to bid farewell to the oud too. I'll become a craftsman, just like my father hoped I would..."

dialogues.speaker: Battered Notebook
dialogues.text: (There seems to be more, but it's been crossed and blacked out with ink.)

dialogues.speaker: Battered Notebook
dialogues.text: "...To who's reading this notebook, if I by some miracle am allowed to meet Aranakin and the others again, years from now, then please give this flower to him..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like... a flower? It looks... exactly like the flower we got.
